name: Robots Enact Malignant Stereotypes
summary: Audits a CLIP-powered language-conditioned manipulation policy that packs blocks printed with human faces under commands carrying stereotyped terms, measuring placement rates by race and gender.
numbers: 1.3 million simulated trials, 62 commands; acts out race and gender stereotypes and recognises women and people of colour less often

why.dex: Pick and place poses on a scripted controller.
why.cog: Mapping a command to a face on a block.
why.xr: Physically enacted discrimination against people by identity.
